facts.fact: 塔拉辛在阿拉里克咬上她脖颈时发出嘶声。
facts.anchor: Talasyn hissed as Alaric’s teeth sank into her neck.

facts.fact: 她想起在锡格瓦德红树林沼泽里的一次秘密会面。
facts.anchor: a clandestine meeting amidst the mangrove swamps of Sigwad

facts.fact: 伊德丝·维拉要的不只是收复全盟失地。
facts.anchor: Ideth Vela wasn’t aiming to just reclaim the Allfold territories.

facts.fact: 大湾城连同那些笑脸与落在她身上的花瓣都已被抹去。
facts.anchor: The beautiful city of Grand Bight, with all those smiling faces and the petals raining down on her—it was all gone.

facts.fact: 是她招来的紫晶色光芒把奔逃中的人烧烂。
facts.anchor: she had brought about the amethyst light that had come for them and rotted them even as they tried to run from it

facts.fact: 她几乎能看见乌尔杜佳在天上之天朝她冷笑。
facts.anchor: She could almost see Urduja smirking at her from the Sky Above the Sky.

facts.fact: 阿拉里克龇着被吻肿的嘴唇说这改变不了什么。
facts.anchor: “This changes nothing,” he snarled, baring his teeth at her through kiss-bitten lips.
“I’ll see you on the battlefield,” he said at last.
